text:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F-1",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "CH-17 notes that dedicated PK subgroup visits V2.1 (Day 2), V2.2 (Day 6 ±1), V2.3 (Day 10 ±1), V7.1 (Day 72), V7.2 (Day 76), V7.3 (Day 80 ±1), and V8.1 (Day 90 ±2) are missing from the EDC build, and no operation adds these events or schedules the PK form at them. Furthermore, the 480 h (Day 90 / V8.1) PK timepoint from page 51 is missing from the PKTPT codelist."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-2",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-10",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-10 restricts only the 48 h, 144 h, and 240 h PK samples on parent visits V2, V7, and V8 to PK substudy participants, whereas Section 6.2.5 and Footnote e of Table 1 (page 45) state that all PK blood sampling is for the Mainland China PK subgroup only. Additionally, logging multi-day PK visits onto parent visits V2, V7, and V8 contradicts Table 1, where V2.1–V2.3, V7.1–V7.3, and V8.1 are distinct scheduled visits with their own day targets and windows, and 48 h, 144 h, and 240 h do not occur at V8 (336 h)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-3",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-08",
      "change_id": "CH-16",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-08 adds the anti-TJ301 antibodies (ADA) collection item ADAPERF to the PK form, which is collected at V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8, and V9, even though Table 1 (page 45) and Figure 5 (page 47) specify ADA sampling only at V2, V3, V4, V6, V8, and V9 (not V5 or V7) and for all patients rather than just the PK subgroup."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-4",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-26",
      "page": 50,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "CH-26 adds patient diary dispensing and diary review to Visit 2 (Baseline) procedures (also shown across Visits 1 through 8 in Table 1 on page 44), but neither the current casebook nor any operation in the diff includes forms or items to capture diary dispensing or diary review."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-5",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-12",
      "page": 35,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "CH-12 expands Exclusion Criterion 17 to require specific latent TB testing (QuantiFERON-TB Gold at Screening, or T-spot within 4 weeks of Randomisation plus chest X-ray within 12 weeks of Randomisation, also detailed on page 87), while the TB form only has a generic TBRES text item and no operation adds test method, chest X-ray, or date fields to verify the exclusion windows."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-6",
      "kind": "uncertain",
      "op_id": "OP-09",
      "change_id": "CH-8",
      "page": 49,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-09 enforces a screening endoscopy window of Day -35 to Day -6 prior to Visit 2 per Inclusion Criterion 4 (page 34) and Table 1 Footnote c (page 45), but Section 6.2.2 (page 49) still states 'Endoscopy conducted within 2 months before Randomisation is acceptable' alongside '-35 to -6 days prior to Randomisation', and Table 1 Footnote b says 'within 35 days before Randomisation'. A reviewer must confirm whether endoscopies outside Day -35 to Day -6 (such as Day -5 to -1 or up to 2 months prior) are strictly invalid or residual text errors."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-7",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-09",
      "change_id": "CH-8",
      "page": 34,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-09 references '$V2.DATE' and function 'days_between(ENDO.ENDODTC, $V2.DATE)' in its rule expression, neither of which appears in the existing casebook schema or rule conventions (existing rule CMP_PK_01 references form items like '$V2.EX.EXSTDTC'), and argument order in 'days_between' could invert the sign of the day difference."
    }
  ],
  "overall_uncertainty": "Because the current casebook appears to be an abbreviated subset omitting forms such as physical examination/vital signs (relevant to CH-19) and patient diary subscore logs, I could not verify whether omitted protocol assessments are handled in external systems (e.g., ePRO or central lab transfers) or missing from the EDC build, nor could I verify the exact expression syntax engine for 'days_between' and '$V2.DATE'."
}
